name: Massachusetts
agency: MassHealth (Executive Office of Health and Human Services)

period.description: Your deductible covers a six-month period and equals six months of your extra income; you meet it again every six months.

submission.description: Send copies of medical bills that add up to your deductible to MassHealth. Forms list the Health Insurance Processing Center in Taunton by mail or fax; call MassHealth to confirm where to send deductible bills.

notes: Unpaid bills you still owe count. Paid bills count if you paid them during the six-month period.
Health insurance premiums, including Medicare, count first toward the deductible.
Bills you use to meet the deductible are yours to pay; MassHealth will not pay them.
Each bill should show the provider, the service and the date. For paid bills, include a receipt or canceled check.
